verdict.rationale: Omnirush is a desktop coding-agent app that routes work to hosted models, so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no such setting or data-usage policy. The option to add your own provider keys is an adjacent feature and does not by itself stop your data being used for training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
